newsitem.title: USA: Colgate names new U.S., European heads.
newsitem.headline: Colgate names new U.S., European heads.

text.p: Colgate-Palmolive said on Thursday it promoted Ian Cook, 44, to president of Colgate - U.S. and Javier Teruel, 47, to president of Colgate - Europe.
Cook and Teruel replaced two senior executives who were promoted as part of Colgate's global management restructuring, the company said ealier in the week.

Cook, who had held the number two position at Colgate - U.S. operations, succeeded Lois Juliber, who was named executive vice president, responsible for all of Colgate's operations in North America and Europe, it said.
Teruel succeeds David Metzler, who was named executive vice president, responsible for all of Colgate-U.S. operations in Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Africa and Eastern Europe.
These appointments were effective March 1, it said.
Colgate said on January 14 it was refining its organizational structure to reflect Colgate's growth prospects in both the developing and developed worlds.
